device.name: Siglent SDS2000X Plus through lxkang00/oscilloscope-mcp (SCPI transport)

facts.text: The pinned server is one MCP server script that controls a Siglent SDS2000X Plus over raw TCP SCPI on port 5024.
SCPI_PORT is 5024.
OscilloscopeConnection is a persistent TCP socket wrapper with connect, disconnect, send, query and safe_query.
send() appends a newline and reads a response when the command contains a question mark.
query() appends a question mark when the command does not end with one.
measure passes ':MEASure:<item>? <source>', which ends with the source and not with a question mark, to query().
get_id queries *IDN?.
run and stop send :RUN and :STOP; neither queries a stopped state.
reset sends *RST and sleeps for three seconds.
configure_channel writes display, invert, scale, offset, coupling, bandwidth limit, probe, skew, unit and label commands under :CHANnelN:.
get_channel queries eight channel settings; the pinned handler swallows each query error as N/A.
configure_timebase writes :TIMebase:SCALe, :DELay and :MODE, and get_timebase queries them.
configure_trigger writes sweep and type first and then source, level, slope and coupling under the selected trigger type; holdoff is written under :TRIGger:HOLDoff.
configure_acquisition writes mode, memory depth and interpolation under :ACQuire: and average count under :ACQuire:AVERage.
measure sends :MEASure:<item>? <sources>, or :MEASure:ALL? for the ALL item.
get_measure_stats queries count, mean, min, max and standard deviation.
get_waveform_preamble sends :WAVeform:SOURce and queries :WAVeform:PREamble?, parsing ten comma-separated fields.
get_waveform_data requests ASCII data and returns only a text summary with min, max, mean and the first and last ten values; it does not return the array.
get_screenshot writes a PNG to a local file and returns only a 200-character base64 prefix.
configure_display, configure_cursors, get_cursor_values, configure_math and configure_digital write the corresponding :DISPlay, :CURSor, :MATH and :DIGital subsystems.
save_setup and recall_setup validate a 1-40 character filename and send :STORe:SETup or :RECAll:SETup with the resulting path.
get_frequency_counter queries :COUNter:CURRent?, :COUNter:MODE? and :COUNter:SOURce?.
get_status queries acquisition state, trigger state, *OPC? and *ESR?.
get_next_error queries :SYSTem:ERRor?.
list_tools returns TOOLS and call_tool dispatches HANDLERS by name; the tools are not separate decorated functions.
send_command passes the caller's command string unchanged to send(), an arbitrary SCPI escape.
The socket reader returns what it has read, possibly an empty string, when the reply times out.
_sanitize_label rejects semicolons and enforces at most 20 characters.
_validate_filename accepts only 1-40 letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and underscores.
The channel input schema declares minimum 1 and maximum 4.
The get_channel input schema declares minimum 1 and maximum 4.
The display intensity input schema declares minimum 0 and maximum 100.
